title: JOYFUL
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

session.prompt: Name an affliction testing your patience right now — what would it look like to meet it joyful in hope?
Pray for someone in affliction who needs hope today.
Thank God for a hope that has carried you through a difficult time.

coaching_notes: Load. Recovery. Adaptation. If there's no load there's little chance of growth. When you see affliction as load, it changes your perspective.
